date_note: Date is ZOZO's announcement of 20 November; PLAID notified ZOZO of the unauthorized access on 13 November.
title: ZOZO: about 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN customers' data leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
summary: ZOZO said on 20 November that customer information it managed on PLAID's KARTE leaked. About 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN customers incl. former members (member ID, age, gender, postal code) are affected, about 47,000 of them also with login name, email and phone number; about 13.93 million WEAR by ZOZO customers; about 24,000 brand staff. Passwords are not managed in KARTE; card data is not confirmed leaked.
plain: ZOZO says data of about 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN customers leaked via PLAID's KARTE. Passwords are not held there; card data is not confirmed leaked.
exec: About 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN customer profiles at a large online fashion retailer exposed via a vendor.
action: ZOZO customers: be wary of phishing emails, texts or calls impersonating ZOZO, and do not open their links or attachments, as ZOZO advises.

validation.note: ZOZO's own notice (primary) read, agreeing with Cybersecurity.com's report on the figures.

review.note: Compared title, 15.18M/47,000/13.93M/24,000 figures, data types, password and card statements, 20 Nov date and phishing advice against ZOZO notice and Cybersecurity.com
